description: Share of the log rise in the fatal share due to the number of fatal crashes (numerator) and to the number of reported crashes with a determinable outcome (denominator), under the imputed and the complete-case outcome
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Weighted totals, joint linearisation (25 strata / 67 PSUs, t 42 df); CIs cover CRSS sampling only

definitions.fatal_cc: complete-case maximum severity (MAX_SEV; crashes with a person of unknown severity excluded unless fatal)
